shortDescription: Coinglass data shows that if BTC breaks above $82,874, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges would reach $1.356 billion. According to ChainCatcher, if BTC falls below $75,576, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges would reach $1.132 billion.

title: BTC Liquidation Pressure Rises Above $82,874 and Below $75,576
